sourceFacts.claim: `sale.order` is described as `Sales Order`; its required `partner_id` is labeled `Customer`, `user_id` is labeled `Salesperson`, and `order_line` contains `sale.order.line` Order Lines.
Sales Order requires a Customer and a child Items table whose options are Sales Order Item; Order Type values are Sales, Maintenance, and Shopping Cart.
llx_commande stores an order header with ref, ref_client, fk_soc, dates, author/modifier/validator/closer users and fk_statut.
Tryton's source-native sales object is sale.sale (Sale), with sale.line records and Party participation.
A sales order concerns a customer, ordered products or services, payment term and method, billing and shipping addresses, and delivery instructions.

`sale.order.partner_id`, `partner_invoice_id`, and `partner_shipping_id` relate to `res.partner`; `order_line` relates to `sale.order.line` through inverse `order_id`, and `invoice_ids` relates to `account.move`.
Sales Order links Customer to Customer, Items to Sales Order Item, Amended From to Sales Order, and Customer Address and Contact Person to Address and Contact.
llx_commandedet rows relate to llx_commande through fk_commande and may relate to fk_parent_line and fk_product.
sale.sale relates to sale.line through Lines and exposes Invoices, Shipments, Shipment Returns and Stock Moves.
OrderRole relates OrderHeader, Party, PartyRole, RoleType, and OrderItem using orderId, partyId, and roleTypeId.

Native operations include `action_quotation_send`, `action_quotation_sent`, `action_confirm`, `action_cancel`, `action_draft`, `_create_invoices`, `create`, `write`, and deletion guarding through `_unlink_except_draft_or_cancel`.
Sales Order validates, submits, cancels, updates status, creates Delivery Note, and creates Sales Invoice through named controller methods.
Commande::valid validates an order, optionally using an idwarehouse, and returns negative on failure, zero when nothing is done, or positive on success.
Sale operations include quote, confirm, cancel, draft and process; process handles invoice, fulfillment and state updates.
Order entry captures Product Store and Customer Details, adds items to cart, sets shipping and payment terms, and creates the Order.
`create(vals_list)` assigns a `sale.order` sequence name and returns created records; `action_confirm()` operates on quotations, writes confirmation values, and documents a Boolean `True` return.
make_delivery_note maps Sales Order data toward Delivery Note, and the whitelisted make_sales_invoice operation accepts source_name and a target Sales Invoice document input.
Commande::addline takes native desc, pu_ht, qty, tax, product, discount, date, type, unit, origin and reference inputs for an order line.
Sale inputs include required Company, Party and Currency plus Lines; outputs include Number, amounts, invoices, shipments and states.
createOrderFromShoppingCart takes shoppingCart as INOUT and returns orderId as OUT.

`SALE_ORDER_STATE` declares `draft` Quotation, `sent` Quotation Sent, `sale` Sales Order, and `cancel` Cancelled; `action_quotation_sent`, `action_confirm`, `action_cancel`, and `action_draft` perform native transitions.

Sales Order Status values are Draft, On Hold, To Pay, To Deliver and Bill, To Bill, To Deliver, Completed, Cancelled, and Closed; close_or_unclose_sales_orders closes eligible submitted orders and reopens Closed orders by update_status Draft.
Commande statuses are STATUS_CANCELED=-1, STATUS_DRAFT=0, STATUS_VALIDATED=1, STATUS_SHIPMENTONPROCESS=2 and STATUS_CLOSED=3.
Sale State is exactly Draft, Quotation, Confirmed, Processing, Done or Cancelled, with the source transition set declared by Sale.__setup__.
ORDER_STATUS defines Created, Processing, Approved, Sent, Held, Completed, Rejected, and Cancelled with explicit StatusValidChange rows.

`action_quotation_sent` marks a draft quotation as sent, and `action_confirm` confirms quotations and sets their confirmation date; tracked `state` changes are observable through the model's mail tracking inheritance.
Sales Order handles before_validate, validate, on_submit, on_cancel, on_update_after_submit, and before_update_after_submit lifecycle events.
Successful validation calls the ORDER_VALIDATE trigger unless triggers are disabled.
Confirm schedules Sale.process through cls.__queue__ using sale_process_after and queue context.
StatusValidChange transition names include Process Order, Approve Order, Hold Order, Reject Order, Cancel Order, Send Order, and Complete Order.
Only draft orders may be marked sent directly; confirmation calls `_confirmation_error_message`; deletion permits only `draft` or `cancel`; confirmed orders reject `pricelist_id` changes.
Closing or reopening Sales Orders requires Sales Order write permission; closing applies only to submitted orders not already Cancelled or Closed and not both fully delivered and fully billed.
Commande::valid does nothing when status is already STATUS_VALIDATED.
Quote calls check_for_quotation before setting Quotation Date and Number; process filters to Confirmed, Processing or Done.
Approved Order guidance requires checking shipping information, billing details, and requested shipping dates before Approve Order.
The `_date_order_conditional_required` constraint requires a non-null `date_order` when state is `sale`; `_check_order_line_company_id` rejects products from an inaccessible company branch.
Sales Order cancellation refuses a Closed order and refuses cancellation while linked draft Sales Invoices exist.
llx_commande requires ref, entity and fk_soc; rowid is primary key and fk_statut defaults to 0.
Sale deletion is permitted only while State is Cancelled or Draft.
Sales Order document is created with a unique reference number used for customer service and issue reporting.

`UserError` is raised for invalid sent/confirm/delete/pricelist operations, while `_check_order_line_company_id` raises `ValidationError` when a quotation contains products from another inaccessible company.
Sales Order throws WarehouseRequired when a stock Item needs a source Warehouse, throws when a Closed order is cancelled, and throws PermissionError when close_or_unclose lacks write permission.
Orders::_fetch rejects missing read right, absent ID/ref/ref_ext, missing order and denied commande resource access with REST errors.
Sale source defines SaleValidationError, SaleQuotationError, SaleConfirmError, SaleMoveQuantity and PartyLocationError.
callProcessOrderPayments requires shoppingCart and binds a missing value to OrderRequiredFieldMissingShoppingCart.
Readback fields include `state`, `date_order`, `amount_untaxed`, `amount_tax`, `amount_total`, `invoice_status`, `invoice_ids`, `invoice_count`, `signature`, `signed_by`, and `signed_on`.
Sales Order onload exposes can_update_items and reserved-stock flags; cancellation persists status Cancelled through db_set, while update_status calls notify_update and clears DocType notifications.
GET {id}/lines fetches the Commande, checks read/resource access, loads getLinesArray and returns cleaned order lines.
Sale readbacks include Untaxed, Tax and Total amounts, Invoice State, Shipment State, To Invoice and To Ship.
Current order status tells the state at a given time; Find Orders lists existing Orders for completion or modification.
